description: This file defines the AuthenticationController class, which manages user authentication including login, session validation, and logout in the SuiteCRM project. It includes logic for handling different authentication methods and integrating hooks and configurations.

classes.name: AuthenticationController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing user authentication processes, including login, session validation, and logout within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the authentication controller, selecting the appropriate authentication method based on configuration and request context.

methods.name: getAuthController
methods.description: Returns an instance of a specific authentication method class, dynamically loading class files as needed.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Implements singleton pattern to get a single instance of AuthenticationController.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login attempts, manages session variables, and triggers hooks and redirects based on login success or failure.

methods.name: sessionAuthenticate
methods.description: Validates the current session to ensure the user is authenticated, updating user stats if valid.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user, clearing session data and invoking logout hooks.
